# proxy

```go
import "banyan/addon/proxy"
```

The proxy addon provides an HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy server with special routing for .fig and .peer domains. It enables transparent access to remote services and peers through the Banyan network.

.fig domains \(e.g., myservice.fig\) are resolved via the management API to find the associated peer, then tunneled through the p2p connection.

.peer domains \(e.g., peerID.peer or alias.peer\) route directly to specific peers, supporting both full peer IDs and 4\-character aliases.

Usage:

```
proxy [-port PORT] [-addr ADDR]
```

The addon requires BANYAN\_MGMT\_URL to be set by the addon manager.
